summary: A mixed legal and retail day led by a Delhi High Court ban on energy drink production affecting major beverage suppliers including Reliance, alongside positive earnings guidance from Dabur India and upcoming Reliance/Jio IPO valuations.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court bars PepsiCo, Monster from manufacturing energy drinks; existing stocks may be sold but no new production permitted.
Reliance challenges Delhi High Court ban on marketing Campa drinks as energy drinks; court questioned FSSAI for issuing order without notice.
Dabur India expects double-digit consolidated revenue growth in Q2 FY27, with strong India FMCG business performance anticipated.
Jio Platforms targets $114 billion valuation in planned October 21 IPO launch, marking major capital raise for Ambani group.
McDonald's supplier HyFun Foods plans ₹20 billion ($208 million) IPO in late 2028, expanding food services investment activity.
